# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 1 token; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 28 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 1 token; Size — 9 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the mint-dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--color-canvas, #141418);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="mint-light" or "lilac-dark" or "lilac-light" or "sand-dark" or "sand-light" or "contrast-dark" or "contrast-light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from that theme’s column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--color-canvas, #f1f1f4);   /* the mint-light theme’s value */
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #141418;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | mint-dark | mint-light | lilac-dark | lilac-light | sand-dark | sand-light | contrast-dark | contrast-light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--color-canvas` | #141418 | #f1f1f4 | #141320 | #f2f1f8 | #171512 | #f3efe8 | #000000 | #ebebed | App background behind panels; also the field fill of inputs and command blocks. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 18px/1.4 "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-title);
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 18px / 1.4 | 600 | `sans` | Dialog titles, empty state titles, settings page titles. |
| `heading` | `.heading`, `--text-heading` | 15px / 1.4 | 600 | `sans` | Task header title, board heading, section heads. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 14px / 1.5 | 400 | `sans` | App base size. Task titles in the list (500), tile titles (600), running text. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 13px / 1.5 | 500 | `sans` | Buttons, tabs, segmented control, status labels, inputs. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 12px / 1.5 | 400 | `sans` | Hints, notes, status bar. The smallest size anywhere in the UI. |
| `group-label` | `.group-label`, `--text-group-label` | 12px / 1.5 | 600 | `sans` | Sidebar group heads and inspector section heads. |
| `meta` | `.meta`, `--text-meta` | 12px / 1.5 | 400 | `mono` | Branches, ages, diff stats, counts, kbd. |
| `terminal` | `.terminal`, `--text-terminal` | 13px / 1.5 | 400 | `mono` | Terminal (xterm.js), command blocks in the approval bar, tile previews. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"JetBrains Mono", D2Coding, ui-monospace, monospace` |

## Spacing

A 4px base. Fixed chrome rhythm uses 14px and 18px side insets, written out in components.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon to text in dense rows, group head bottom padding. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gap inside rows, small button padding, task row vertical rhythm. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Button side padding, board gap, approval padding. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Board padding, sidebar empty state padding. |
| `--space-5` | 20px | Dialog padding. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Section gaps in settings and dialogs. |
| `--space-10` | 40px | Gap between settings sections and board columns' top inset. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Empty state padding. |

## Size

Fixed chrome sizes. Hit targets are 24px minimum and 28px by default (desktop, pointer first).

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--size-titlebar: 40px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--size-titlebar), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--size-titlebar` | 40px | Title bar height. |
| `--size-statusbar` | 24px | Status bar height. |
| `--size-row` | 28px | Default control height: buttons, icon buttons, inputs in the chrome, search. |
| `--size-tabs` | 34px | Terminal tab strip height. |
| `--size-task-header` | 60px | Task header (title line plus branch line). |
| `--size-sidebar` | 288px | Task list width. |
| `--size-inspector` | 360px | Inspector width. |
| `--size-inspector-wide` | 560px | Inspector width while a diff is open side by side (Changes). The person can drag between 320px and 50% of the window. |
| `--size-dialog` | 480px | Width of confirm dialogs and the report form. New task is 560px, settings 760px, quick open 640px. |
